messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: anomalous kvcache activity detected on pool-3 (memory + error-rate spike). window=5m, kv_keys ↑, failed requests ↗. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/alerts/1899990001 :rotating_light:

maria-oncall: I'm on it. jumping into pool-3 pod logs now. any immediate impact visible to customers?

jake-support: seeing ~40 customer requests returning 500s and stalled streams between 10:02-10:07 UTC. some customers reported token truncation. raising severity to P1.

leo-sre: quick summary from tails: KV key cardinality exploded due to many short-lived draft-prefixed keys from speculative decoding. continuous-batcher then consolidated many tiny requests into large inflight batches -> batch amplification and memory pressure. short excerpt:

```
[2026-03-16T10:02:11Z] pool-3: kv_entries=2.1M, kv_mem=46GB, inflight_batches=520
[2026-03-16T10:02:18Z] speculative: created draft_key: draft/req/0x9f2/seq=3
[2026-03-16T10:02:19Z] target-sync: no target_id for req 0x9f2 -> leaving draft-only entry
```

sandra-runtime: we have a few knobs that are low risk to flip live. proposal A: feature-flag speculative-decoding=false for hosted routes (dynamic config). Proposal B: shrink continuous_batch.max_tokens on pool-3 from 4096 -> 768. Proposal C: set kv_cache.max_entries=250000 and kv_cache.ttl=180s to force eviction. Also consider routing a fraction to model-fallback as a safety net.

maria-oncall: do the config flips require rolling restarts? need ETA to safe state.

sandra-runtime: speculative flag is via config-service and takes effect within ~20s. batch size & kv caps will be rolled as config reloads on each node; should be non-disruptive but expect transient increased latency as older batches drain. I'll coordinate a controlled rollout to pool-3.

deploy-bot: Starting config rollout: set speculative=false on pool-3 (user=maria-oncall) -> accepted.

deploy-bot: Config update applied to 10/12 nodes in pool-3. Remaining nodes updating (drain/cordon in progress).

leo-sre: initial datapoint after speculative=false: kv_entries down 45% in 90s, p95 latency improved but p99 tail still elevated. memory stabilized on nodes updated.

maria-oncall: initiating batch-size reduction now. will throttle rollout to <=2 nodes concurrently.

sandra-runtime: applying continuous_batch.max_tokens=768 and kv_cache.max_entries=250000, kv_cache.ttl=180s. patch: ```
PATCH /config/v1/pools/pool-3
{
  "continuous_batch": {"max_tokens": 768},
  "kv_cache": {"max_entries": 250000, "ttl_secs": 180}
}
```

deploy-bot: rolling config applied to pool-3 nodes (3/12 updated).

mina-ml: disabling speculative will change decoding latency/quality profile for some prompts; we're tracking evals. filing follow-up: https://git.redwood/ML/issues/801. We'll prioritize fix for draft->target commit path that leaves dangling draft keys.

leo-sre: after full rollout (pool-3), metrics now: kv_entries=210k, kv_mem=6.5GB, inflight_batches=82. error-rate down to baseline. p99.99 latency back to normal ~750ms.

jake-support: customer impact feed: majority of affected customers saw <30s disruption; we alerted two enterprise customers (acct-8423, acct-9218) and offered logs + RCA.

maria-oncall: handing off to tomo-oncall for 3:00h postmortem follow-up and watch. tomo-oncall: please pick up monitoring + coord with ML for the bugfix.

tomo-oncall: ack, I'll run the postmortem and coordinate rollback/groups.

maria-oncall: follow-ups assigned:
- RUNTIME-1123 (sandra-runtime): add guard to avoid creating draft-only cache entries when target sync fails.
- ML-801 (mina-ml): fix speculative commit race and add unit/regression tests.
- OPS-2190 (leo-sre): add an automated circuit-breaker when kv_entries > 1M for any pool to auto-throttle speculative traffic.

deploy-bot: incident resolved by config mitigations at 10:14 UTC. closing pager. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: kvcache pool-3 memory spike mitigated. summary: speculative-decoding path introduced many ephemeral draft keys that missed target commit, causing continuous-batching amplification and memory blowout. mitigation: speculative decoding disabled on pool-3, continuous_batch reduced, kv_cache caps set, fraction of traffic routed to fallback model until fix. RCA follow-up scheduled.

maria-oncall: handing off complete. thanks team. :heart:
